subject.title: feat(memory-core): optional cross-encoder rerank stage for memory search

question: Should OpenClaw accept this new public MemoryRerankProvider SDK seam with a memoryRerankProviders manifest gate, exclusive single-slot registration, and builtin-only qmd scope?
rationale: The remaining blocker is not a concrete patch defect; it is whether this public plugin API and manifest contract should become the durable OpenClaw memory reranking boundary.

options.title: Approve This SDK Seam After Rebase
options.body: Accept the current API shape, require a conflict-free rebase that preserves current abort handling, and land after targeted memory/plugin/docs checks.

options.title: Revise The Contract First
options.body: Request changes to the manifest gate, slot model, qmd scope, or exported types before any public SDK surface ships.

options.title: Pause Behind The RFC
options.body: Keep this PR parked while maintainers choose between this generic seam, the external-reranker plugin approach, or another design.

recommendation.title: Approve This SDK Seam After Rebase
recommendation.body: Accept the current API shape, require a conflict-free rebase that preserves current abort handling, and land after targeted memory/plugin/docs checks.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is centered on public plugin SDK shape and core/plugin boundary policy, where steipete is the clearest recent routing signal from current-main history.
